propositions: The jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses config keys became inert after task f020 deleted the inbound absence-probe port, which was their only reader; they must be deprecated with a warning and scheduled for removal in v1.0.0.

Both config keys were live and behaviour-affecting in shipped release v0.10.1 and documented to operators as required when workflow names differ, so hard removal without deprecation is a user-visible breaking change requiring operator sign-off.

The write-only DC transport plumbing (_resolved_statuses attribute, NamedTuple field, DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES constant, and ctor kwarg) must be removed as it stores the config value but nothing consumes it, and this removal requires updating both read-via markers to point to the follow-up hard-removal ticket.

Config parsing must remain unchanged—existing configs load identically—but coerce_sparse must emit a deprecation warning when either key is present, warning operators that the keys are scheduled for removal in v1.0.0.

Documentation in config.md and user-guide.md must consistently describe both keys as deprecated, inert, and scheduled for removal, fixing the pre-existing inconsistency about which key the f020 inertness was attributed to.
